name: JANUS_MATHEMATICAL_ALGEBRAIC_PARADOX_RULE
purpose: Use exact paradox-like changes of representation as a machine-synthesis grammar for proof search without allowing heuristic promotion or information loss to masquerade as mathematics.
core_principle: SEARCH_FOR_EXACT_REPRESENTATION_CHANGES_WHERE_EXPLICIT_DIMENSION_STATE_VOLUME_OR_PROOF_VOLUME_COLLAPSES_WHILE SEMANTICS INFORMATION AND REPLAYABILITY REMAIN CERTIFIED IN A LATENT ALGEBRAIC FIBER.

paradox_definition.meaning_here: A rigorously verified mismatch between two resource views of the same mathematical object, such as fewer explicit coordinates but more proof material, or exponentially many concrete states represented by polynomially many symmetry types.
paradox_definition.not_allowed_meaning: A rhetorical contradiction, numerical coincidence, mystical claim, or unverified shortcut.

canonical_paradox_families.name: JANUS Algebraic Compression / Proof-Volume Paradox
canonical_paradox_families.use: Search for a second representation in which the proof language, not the raw CNF, is the correct resource carrier.

canonical_paradox_families.name: Orbit / Fiber Compression
canonical_paradox_families.use: Replace enumerated symmetry images by orbit representatives and a certified generator action.

canonical_paradox_families.name: Exchangeability Histogram Quotient
canonical_paradox_families.use: Represent interchangeable blocks by exact type multiplicities instead of block-by-block assignments.

canonical_paradox_families.name: Reversible Coordinate Fold
canonical_paradox_families.use: Move information into an internal exact coordinate while preserving an inverse or proof-carrying replay.

canonical_paradox_families.name: Algebraic Cancellation
canonical_paradox_families.use: Exploit exact cancellation, basis change, polynomial identities, or conserved flow only when verification remains bounded.

current_application.pipeline: RAW_CNF -> AUTO_DISCOVER_GADGETS -> AUTO_DISCOVER_BLOCKS -> CERTIFY_S_k -> SYNTHESIZE_LOCAL_ALPHABET -> HISTOGRAM_QUOTIENT -> EXACT_CERTIFICATE
